sourceSentences: Vault Breaker's dash range extends up to 50 units when going through a wall.
Casting Flash during the dash will cause enemies at the destination to be hit by Vault Breaker.
As Flash updates Vi's facing direction, affected champions will be knocked back in the direction the summoner spell was cast in.
Relentless Force [Vi] and Cease and Desist [Vi] can be cast during the dash.
Vi channel [charges] while being slow [slowed] by 15% for up to 4 seconds to increase Vault Breaker's range, speed, and damage over the first 1.25 seconds of the channel.
If the charge completes without reactivation, Vault Breaker is cancelled, mana [50% of the mana cost] is refunded, and it is placed on cd [full cooldown].
Vault Breaker [Vi] will trigger Blast Shield even if it's blocked by a spell shield. Cease and Desist [Vi] will not.
Blast Shield's cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds each time Denting Blows [Vi] is consumed.
Vi's basic attacks on-hit and Vault Breaker [Vi] apply a stack of Denting Blows to enemies hit for 4 seconds
The third stack consumes them all to deal bonus physical damage, capped at 300 against non-champions, and inflict armor penetration [20% armor reduction] for 4 seconds.
The armor penetration will apply after the triggering damage.

Vi empowers her next basic attack within 6 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, gain range [50 bonus range] and trigger a blast in the target's direction that deals modified physical damage to enemies hit in a cone.
Relentless Force basic attack reset [resets] Vi's basic attack timer.
If the Relentless Force buff is about to run out as Vi starts the attack windup, the duration will be updated and extended to allow Vi to still sucessfully attack.
Vi will track the target if they change locations.
She will not dash through the target if she would not be able to land to the opposite side of them, such as by terrain.
The dash will not be overridden if Vi blink [blinks] during it.
Flash cannot be used during the grab.
Relentless Force is usable. Vault Breaker is disabled.
Enemies she dashes through are dealt the same damage, airborne [knocked aside] by 350 units over 0.25 seconds, and stun [stunned] for 0.75 seconds.
The first is Vi's most basic combo, which is the Q animation, basic attack, and E. Her E resets the basic attack
with the Q Flash all you need to do is flash at them and you'll hit them.
So, during Q, you can start channeling your ultimate and you'll be able to cancel the animation.
This way , you'll use your QR immediately on the target and neutralize it completely
if you start with your ultimate and they use Flash afterwards, you can use Q on them, and you'll be able to apply all the damage
And you can use Flash during your ultimate to redirect it and hit all targets.
You can hold your Q for a long time, and players don't know this, and enemies definitely don't know this either.
Next up is a mechanic you also need to start using, which is the E on minions and towers.
We'll save the Q to get over the wall here.
Ulti, auto Q, auto E, hit him. Doesn't really matter if he flashes.
